pre_survey.title: Pre-Study Survey
pre_survey.description: Please answer the following questions before starting the coding task. All questions are required.

questions.question: What is your current education level?
How much experience do you have in programming?
How frequently do you use AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot?

questions.content: Please answer the following questions with respect to your usage of GitHub Copilot. Choose N/A if you have no experience with the tool.

image.alt: GitHub Copilot AI coding assistant demonstration

questions.question: Github Copilot is very reliable. I can trust on it to be correct all the time.
questions.help_text: Choose N/A if you have no experience with the tool

questions.question: Please describe why you trust or distrust GitHub Copilot for use in coding in your own words.
questions.placeholder: Describe the factors that influence your trust or distrust in AI coding assistants...

questions.question: Please describe in your own words, how you think GitHub Copilot generates code suggestions?
questions.placeholder: Explain your understanding of how AI generates code suggestions...

questions.question: How accurate do you believe GitHub Copilot's code suggestions are?
questions.help_text: Move the slider to indicate your perceived accuracy (0% = completely inaccurate, 100% = perfectly accurate)

questions.question: Please describe what you believe might cause GitHub Copilot's code suggestions to be incorrect.
questions.placeholder: Describe potential causes of incorrect AI-generated code...

questions.question: How do you think GitHub Copilot's code suggestions affect your ability to complete programming assignments?
questions.placeholder: Describe how AI coding assistants impact your programming work...

questions.question: How do you think GitHub Copilot learns from both your code and code written by other developers?
questions.placeholder: Describe your understanding of how Copilot learns from data...

post_survey.title: Post-Study Survey
post_survey.description: Thank you for completing the task! Please share your experience with the AI coding assistant. All questions are required.
